services.name: Jurnii RV Rentals
services.desc: The King Cabin Escape is in a secluded meadow with a private driveway and was designed with elegance and comfort in mind. Enjoy an indoor electric fireplace, BBQ grill on your private outside deck, or take a walk on a nearby trail in the Olympic National Forest. The cabin features 1 bedroom with a King bed, a sleeping loft with a twin bed and a pull out sofa in the living room along with a large refrigerator and fully-stocked kitchen (dishes, appliances, utensils and spices) so you can cook from the comfort of home. blurb: The most centrally located RV park in the area, Elwha RV Park is placed conveniently just minutes from Olympic National Park and six miles from Port Angeles with shops & restaurants and the Victoria, BC Ferry. The first ocean beach and the Olympic Discovery Trail are only a couple miles from our campground.
